jobs.why: r1: read as a waffle knit, no fringe

prompt: Studio product photograph of one 150 x 200 cm throw blanket in pecan, a warm reddish brown, exactly as in the reference image (same colour, weave and texture): crinkled, softly wrinkled multi-layer cotton muslin gauze with a fine shallow grid (not a thick waffle knit), matte, short frayed fringe on all edges. Folded neatly, as sold, into a thick soft rectangle lying flat on the floor of the backdrop, the folded layers visible at the side; one fringed end drapes softly over the front fold so the short frayed fringe is clearly visible along the front, and the fringe also shows at the folded side edges. Only the textile, nothing else. Shot on a seamless warm off-white paper backdrop that sweeps from wall to floor in one even very light warm off-white tone (about #F0E7DB, neither yellow nor grey), no horizon line, no texture. One large soft key light from the upper left with gentle fill; a soft, gentle contact shadow under the product, falling slightly to the lower right. Camera: a three-quarter view from the front-left, the lens about 30 degrees above the floor plane looking down at the product at an angle, not a top-down flat lay, so the front edge, the thickness and the sides of the product and the backdrop sweep behind it are visible; the product centred and filling about 70 percent of the square frame, the whole product in frame with clear empty backdrop margins on all sides. Premium interior catalogue product photograph, photorealistic, crisp true-to-life textile texture, accurate colours, neutral white balance. No props, no plants, no furniture, no people, no text, no logos.
